input: Search the web for kids' "summer program" offerings (programs that don't call themselves camps) for kids and teens in Henderson, Transylvania and Polk counties, NC (Hendersonville, Brevard, Tryon). Use that wording in your searches, not just "camp", and list every organization you find.

candidates.name: Brevard College
candidates.note: Campus Adventures for rising grades 1–7 ran July 20–24, 2026; also offered a high-school Choral Institute in July 2025.

candidates.name: Brevard Music Center
candidates.note: Summer institute includes intensive music study for teens ages 14 and older; documented for summer 2025.

candidates.name: Boys & Girls Club of Henderson County
candidates.note: Supervised summer youth programming and academic support; summer 2026 attendance documented by the Club.

candidates.name: Roseland Community Center
candidates.note: Free RISE! summer enrichment for ages 6–13 ran June 15–July 1, 2026, with full days Monday–Thursday and Friday mornings.

candidates.name: Polk County Public Libraries
candidates.note: June–August 2026 Summer Learning included in-person activities and events for kids and teens at both branches.

candidates.name: Transylvania County Library
candidates.note: Summer 2026 reading program included scheduled activities for children and teens and a June 10 kickoff with crafts and games.

candidates.name: Henderson County Public Library
candidates.note: June 1–July 31, 2026 summer reading program included scheduled in-person events for preschoolers, children and teens.

candidates.name: Polk County Schools
candidates.note: Free weeklong 2026 Summer Seminars for advanced-learning and AIG students covered robotics, 3D printing, art, herbalism and space.

candidates.name: N.C. Cooperative Extension — Transylvania County Center
candidates.note: Offered a 2025 Summer Fun series with supervised hands-on activities and learning experiences.
